remarks: Welcome to your private oasis! Just behind the gated driveway lies this extraordinary property, nestled on a sprawling 1.1-acre lot, offers the perfect blend of comfort and natural beauty. The main house features 5 spacious bedrooms and 3 full baths on the main level providing ample space for family and guests, each room filled with natural light. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with top-of-the-line appliances, granite counters, and a large island, perfect for culinary enthusiasts. Enjoy the elegant living space featuring high ceilings, hardwood floors, and a cozy fireplace. The master suite is an over-sized private sanctuary with a spa-like ensuite bathroom, walk-in closet. Lower level features a entertainers dream family room with a walkout to the backyard and a large bar to host a multitude of events. This level also includes an in-law apartment with full eat in kitchen. Suite also includes a full bathroom, sliding glass doors to the patio which provide ample sunlight and a fireplace. Step outside to discover an entertainer's dream! The meticulously landscaped grounds include an inground pool with a waterfall and grotto, offering a resort-like experience in your own backyard. The expansive patio is perfect for outdoor dining and lounging, surrounded by lush greenery. Beautiful gardens with manicured lawns, flower beds, and mature trees create a picturesque setting.
